title: CPT invariance and Lorentz covariance

numpy_complex_safety.note: numpy 2x2 complex matmul + dagger match a from-scratch complex impl to <1e-13; real+imag both preserved, so numpy is trusted for the SL(2,C) block.

cpt_jarlskog.note: No CPT-violating asymmetry: J=0 exactly, p/antip symmetric to numerical floor.

doppler_lv.note: Doppler matches SR sqrt[(1-b)/(1+b)] to machine precision in the continuum limit. The split-step Weyl kernel is exactly linear so its measured finite-k residue is ~machine-zero, well within (does not exceed) the FA01 group-velocity k^2 envelope (-1/54).
